title: Read the configuration structure
summary: Nginx configuration uses directives and blocks. Some directives are valid only in specific contexts.
introduction: Nginx configuration uses directives and blocks. Some directives are valid only in specific contexts. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Nginx configuration uses directives and blocks. Some directives are valid only in specific contexts.
The server block sits inside http. The listen directive binds the practice server to localhost port 8080.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A directive in the wrong context can make configuration validation fail.
For more detail later, use this [Nginx further reading](https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html).
